title: fxv workspace optimize command payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv workspace optimize` command's JSON output, emitted when nothing failed. A failed optimize is an error envelope whose `error_data` has `kind` `workspace-optimize-failed`.

bytes_processed.description: Bytes of store files merged, across both repositories.

draft.description: What the optimize did to this workspace's draft repository, or null when it wasn't asked to optimize it.

published.description: What the optimize did to the published repository, or null when it wasn't asked to optimize it.

bytes_processed.description: Bytes of this repository's store files merged, across every namespace.

namespaces.description: What the optimize did to each namespace's store files.

bytes_processed.description: Bytes of this namespace's store files merged.

skipped.description: True when the namespace's files needed no merge, or another optimize had already merged them.
